scoring_justification: Headline quantities are DFT-computed magnetic moments and energy differences; the verifier cannot re-run DFT, so we compare reported values to paper gold with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden gold values for magnetic moments and energy differences as reported in the paper (Physica B, 2012).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: total moment 7.50 μB, local Cr 3.84 μB, bridging O -0.08 μB, ΔE near 278 meV, ΔE far 26 meV, codoped ΔE 73 meV.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's results (Section 3, Fig. 2, Fig. 3).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported results, ensuring the reproduction target is authentic.

outputs.description: Scored artifact containing the total and local magnetic moments and FM-AFM energy differences for the monodoped supercell configurations.
Scored artifact containing the FM-AFM energy difference for the (Cr,Al)-codoped far supercell configuration.

output_contract.notes: All magnetic moments are in units of Bohr magneton (μB) and energy differences in milli-electronvolts (meV). The hidden checker compares each reported value to the paper's reference values within predefined tolerances.
